cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5)
project(kopterworx_gz)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
# Model (generated by scripts/gen_model.py), the gz -> ROS bridge config and the world.
# There are no launch files: bringup is the tmuxinator session in
# ros2_sitl/startup/kopterworx_flat, one explicit command per pane.
install(DIRECTORY models/ DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME}/models)
install(DIRECTORY config/ DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME}/config)
install(DIRECTORY worlds/ DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME}/worlds)
# <prefix>/share on both paths so package://kopterworx_gz/... resolves in the gz
# server (GZ_SIM_RESOURCE_PATH) and in robot_state_publisher's sdformat_urdf (SDF_PATH).
ament_environment_hooks("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/hooks/${PROJECT_NAME}.dsv.in")
ament_environment_hooks("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/hooks/${PROJECT_NAME}.sh.in")
ament_package()
